turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm a freelance writer and I need help picking a new laptop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to describe each one. Save your comments until the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A small light laptop with an amazing keyboard and eighteen hours of battery, but a fairly dim screen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A two in one with a pen and a touchscreen, nice for notes, but the keyboard is a bit shallow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big fifteen inch one with a great screen and number pad, though it weighs over two kilos.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a writer, the keyboard and battery of the small one are hard to beat, the dim screen matters less indoors. The two in one is fun but a shallow keyboard gets tiring. The big one is great at a desk, but heavy if you work in cafes.
